summary: group[i:j] slices hosts inclusively from i to j; omitted i means 0 and omitted j means the end, [:] is invalid, i > j is empty, and i == j gives one host.
questions: How do I target a range of hosts in a group?
Is the end index in a host slice inclusive?
How do I target all but the first host?

answer_card.title: Slice hosts in a group
answer_card.answer_md:
Slices are **inclusive** of both ends:
```text
webservers[0:2]  # cobweb, webbing, weber
webservers[1:2]  # webbing, weber
webservers[1:]   # webbing, weber
webservers[:3]   # cobweb, webbing, weber
```
Omitting both (`[:]`) is invalid; `i > j` is empty; `i == j` gives one host.
